title: Supply of Rice to the School of St Jude
description: Tender for supply of 70,000 kg Kahama rice grade 2.1 to The School of St Jude, Sisia Campus, Moshono, Arusha. Includes transportation, loading and unloading. Delivery within 5 weeks. Price fixed for minimum 30 days. Sample (0.25 kg) required with submission.

contact.name: Team Lead Purchasing
